decision.reason: No walk-forward probability method improved OOS Brier and log loss enough without using scored games.

priors.note: Rolling features use (sum(window) + 4*prior) / (n + 4); prior shrinks last season with n/(n+8).

live_prediction_impact.description: No serving change. `predict_live_games` still emits the frozen 20260906 isotonic/ridge outputs unless `NFL_V2_POSTHOC_CALIBRATION` is explicitly enabled *and* a shipped artifact exists.

season_2025_note: 2025 reconstructed through the frozen live artifact is **in-sample** (trained_through=2025), n=272. Brier 0.1922, MAE 9.99, book ATS 147-124-1. Stored v1 ATS is 27-29 on 56 games.

season_2025_v1_ats.note: Stored 2025 Supabase ATS is the v1 model, not nfl-v2-live-20260906.
